rejected_rule.statement: An action for the recovery of property is not maintainable without due administration or a period of twenty years having lapsed since the death of the initial owner.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: ...section 547 in unmistakable language rendered an action not maintainable without due administration for the recovery of any property included in an intestate estate. In interpreting that section this court laid down that it formed a statutory bar which could not be got over by the mere acquiescence, or even by the express agreement of the parties to any particular litigation
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 547 of the Civil Procedure Code
